name: Funding-OI joint fragility gate — trend-exhaustion reversal when OI decouples (short, 4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: the reversal side of the joint-fragility gate. When funding_rate SPIKES high (crowded-long carry drag) WHILE open_interest FLATTENS or contracts against a still-positive prior move, the trend has decoupled from fresh money — late trend-followers are piling in without new OI to sustain it, so continuation flips to reversal risk. We short (direction -1) that exhaustion: high funding + FALLING open_interest + an extended prior return (ret_Nd positive, the move that is now unsupported). The short receives the positive funding carry (funding_feature) while the unsupported trend rolls over. Distinct from variant 19 (continuation/long) and from the crowded-long fade 04/06 (which require OI EXPANSION): here the tell is OI DECOUPLING (flattening/falling) beneath a rich-funding extended move. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if the decoupling gate does not improve a plain high-funding-short baseline on the SAME bars net of fees — else it is decorative. DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if it fires too rarely for effective-N, or if the benefit is entirely from 1-2 crash days (regime-luck). DISCONFIRMER 3: kill if in a strong bull leg funding stays pinned high and OI keeps rising so the setup never triggers or the short is run over.
catalyst: high funding + falling OI beneath an extended up-move — an unsupported, exhausted trend to fade short.
